name: Ananya Panday Maine Bohot Struggle Kiya Hai
visual_description: Ananya Panday speaking earnestly during an interview with the subtitle 'Mene bhot struggle kiya hai' at the bottom.
usage_context: Used sarcastically to mock over-dramatic complaints, minor inconveniences, or privileged people claiming hardship.

example.top_text: When my phone battery drops to 20% and the charger is 2 feet away

text_areas.description: The trivial hardship or mock struggle situation
